channel.description: Latest articles from The Asian Age (asianage.com)

item.title: Shikha Mukerjee:‘Detect, Delete, Deport’: SIR Battle Of Perception
item.description: In the past, the Opposition’s purpose, he claimed, was to “normalise infiltration, grant it recognition, and formalise it by adding them to the voters’ list”. The solution, after the SIR, said another minister, was “there will be arrests, and then (people will be sent) straight to detention”

item.title: SC Questions Why Full Leaked Audio Not Sent for Forensic Test
item.description: Bench disturbed that only select portions of audio were examined by forensic agency

item.title: Aakar Patel| Good Governance Gets Much Harder: Are Optics Enough To Satisfy Indians?
item.description: When the airline business grinds to a halt and airports across the country are an angry mess, the solution is to circulate photographs of an airline CEO folding his hands in supplication before the minister. Problem solved. When dozens die in a fire in a structure that shouldn’t have existed in the first place, the solution is to bulldoze the remains of the structure. Of course, thousands of such structures remain

item.title: AA Edit | Fresh Start For BJP With A Young Working Chief
item.description: It may be remembered that several of the party’s chief ministers, including Yogi Adityanath (Uttar Pradesh), Devendra Fadnavis (Maharashtra), Mohan Charan Majhi (Odisha), Mohan Yadav (Madhya Pradesh), Vishnu Deo Sai (Chhattisgarh) and Bhajan Lal Sharma (Rajasthan) were all under 60 when they were chosen for the post. The new young boss will be working with those young veterans

item.title: AA Edit | Bondi terror: Sign Of Our Times
item.description: This is the age of impunity in which many world powers are also seen to be acting without fear of transgressing the rules-based order that has largely driven the world post-World War II, even as nations invade others or attack neighbours with military or state-sponsored terror attacks

item.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Rejects Trump’s “Dead Economy” Remark on India
item.description: While global economic growth is currently around 3.2 per cent, India recorded an 8.2 per cent growth in the last quarter

item.title: K.J. Jacob | Despite Dramatic Win In Its Capital, A Long Way To Go For BJP In Kerala
item.description: Mr Modi's congratulations and blessings will be a shot in the arm for the BJP for its campaign for the Assembly elections due in April-May 2026, but it is doubtful if that is sufficient for the saffron party to confidently aim big, if the performance in the local body elections across the state is a pointer

item.title: AA Edit | Govt Needs To Drop New Rural Jobs Scheme Plan
item.description: Indeed, every salient feature of the MGNREGA scheme is done to death in the new proposed scheme. The most important element of the scheme was that it guarantees 100 days of work for the rural poor and the government was bound to compensate the registered persons monetarily if it could not employ them for the stipulated number of days

item.title: Mohan Guruswamy | How Rising Inequality Leads To Distorting Indian Society
item.description: It is said that an analysis of the Kindle readers of the Piketty book revealed that a typical reader got through 26 of its 700 pages. But have no fear, those first 26 pages have all that you need to know. They encapsulate the rationale and results of Piketty’s monumental work

item.title: AA Edit | Make An Example Of Luthras
item.description: Hardly had the night club they co-owned and operated in Arpora in North Goa started going up in flames just before midnight on December 5 — owing to a lackadaisical flirting with safety in a public place — than the brothers had scooted to Phuket and may have been planning to stay as long as possible away from the long arm of the Indian law
